title: Google Ads
purpose: When Google spend climbs but new sales do not, or products vanish from Shopping, open Google Ads to stop paying for searches and products that never buy and to put the money on the searches that do.
fires: the freelancer's monthly PDF, the Merchant Center emails nobody opens, the search terms report nobody reads, and the habit of trusting Google's own return number
not_for: a store spending under about $1,500 a month on Google, or one whose product pages do not yet turn paid visits into sales

jobs.job: When Google reports a 6 times return and I suspect most of it is people typing our name, tell me what the searches that do not use our name really return, so I judge Google on the buyers it finds, not the ones who were coming anyway
jobs.circumstance: month end, the freelancer's report shows a big return, store new customers are flat, brand and non-brand sit in the same campaigns

progress.functional: split spend and sales between our own name and everything else, in Search, Shopping and Performance Max
progress.emotional: stop the doubt that Google is working at all
progress.social: judge the freelancer on real growth and look sharp to a partner

jobs.hire_today: the freelancer's report, or gut feel
jobs.fire: the blended return in the freelancer's report

forces.push: brand searches hide weak campaigns and the budget keeps going to them
forces.pull: brand and non-brand results side by side, with the brand leak in cold campaigns shown in dollars
forces.habit: the account return is the number everyone quotes
forces.anxiety: what if non-brand turns out to lose money and I have to rethink Google

jobs.little_hire: monthly, and before any Google budget change

watch.metric: non-brand return on ad spend with brand searches excluded, trailing 30 days

drives.metric: new customers from Google non-brand per month

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: the account shows 6x, non-brand alone is 1.9x. After: brand kept out of cold campaigns, non-brand judged on its own and raised to 2.6x in 60 days.
jobs.not_for: a store where nobody searches the brand name yet

progress.functional: the reason for the suspension and a fix list in the order Google checks it

progress.social: look in control to the team while sales are down

jobs.hire_today: the developer guessing, a feed freelancer, or Google support chat

forces.push: every day suspended is Shopping sales lost
forces.pull: the likely cause named from the site and feed, with each fix and the appeal steps

watch.metric: days Shopping stayed down after a suspension

drives.metric: Google revenue lost to suspensions, 90 day

jobs.job: When old stock sits in the warehouse, run a small Google push to clear it at a profit, so I free the cash
jobs.circumstance: a slow product ageing in the warehouse, 6 months of cover, storage costs rising each month

progress.functional: a small campaign for slow products with a margin floor
progress.emotional: stop the weight of dead stock

jobs.hire_today: the founder with a sale

forces.push: cash sits in stock
forces.pull: a small campaign with a floor price
forces.anxiety: what if Google cannot move it

watch.metric: units of slow stock sold through Google per week

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 800 slow units. After: 300 sold in 60 days above cost.
jobs.not_for: a store with no slow stock

jobs.job: When we start shipping to Canada, set up Google by country with its own currency and feed, so I stop showing wrong prices abroad
jobs.circumstance: Canada shipping opened last month, Canadian shoppers see US prices and US delivery times in Shopping

progress.functional: a feed and campaign per country
progress.emotional: stop the embarrassment of wrong prices shown abroad

jobs.hire_today: the agency

forces.push: wrong prices lose clicks and trust
forces.pull: a country setup checklist
forces.anxiety: what if the new country does not pay

watch.metric: Canada Google cost per purchase in local currency, trailing 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: Canada ads show US prices. After: a Canada feed, cost per purchase down 25 percent.
jobs.not_for: a store shipping only in its home country

jobs.job: When Merchant Center has free extras we never turned on, switch them on, so I get more clicks and trust at no cost
jobs.circumstance: a setup review shows free listings, seller ratings and promotions were never switched on

progress.functional: the free extras switched on
progress.emotional: stop the feeling of missing something free

jobs.hire_today: the founder, if they know

forces.push: free clicks left on the table
forces.pull: the 4 extras with on or off
forces.anxiety: what if they show bad reviews
